c.title: $3,500 / 2br - 900ft2 - 2 Bedroom Furnished Suite for Rent in Kitsilano #901 (Kitsilano)
c.description:
Available now!

Fantastic location! This 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom furnished garden suite is located in one of the most sought after neighborhoods in Vancouver. Blocks to Jericho, Locarno and Spanish Bank beaches. Next to West 4th Ave, one of the best shopping and dining destinations in the City, with its trendy shops, coffee shops, restaurants and grocery stores.

- 900 square feet
- Two bedrooms
- One bathroom

The suite feels spacious with its open concept kitchen, living and dining room areas. It is beautifully kept with lovely hardwood flooring in the living room and bedrooms. The living room has comfortable furnishings and large 42" flat screen TV.

The kitchen has white cabinets and nice white tiled backslash and is well stocked for an enjoyable stay. There is a table with seating for 4 and for your convenience there is a desk for your laptop or computer.

The master bedroom has a comfortable queen size bed and the second bedroom has a twin bed, both bedrooms have ample closet space. The large bathroom has a large walk in shower and nice modern sink with plenty of counter space and storage. Electric heating throughout the suite.

Close to Granville Market Island, VGH and UBC. Bus stop just steps away which will get you to a skytrain station, downtown or UBC. Short commute to downtown.

Furnished Suite Rental Features & Amenities:

- In suite laundry
- Wireless internet
- Cable TV
- Microwave
- Free Street parking

Rates per Month:
May to August: $4,500/month
September to April: $3,500/month
Minimum stay 3 months.
Sorry, no pets.

Please quote reference #901 when inquiring about the property.

Please Contact:

Vancouver, BC, Canada
Website: https://www.makeyourselfathome.com
